item.title: GoSign Desktop RCE flaws affecting users in Italy
Don't blindly trust what AI tells you, says Google's Sundar Pichai
item.description:
📝 In an exclusive interview, chief executive Sundar Pichai said that AI models are "prone to errors" and urged people to use them alongside other tools. His comments back up BBC research from earlier this year, which found that AI chatbots inaccurately summarised news stories. For Alphabet, Mr Pichai said managing that tension means being "bold and responsible at the same time".
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8drzv37z4jo
